# UniqTools

UniqTools is an open-source Python ecosystem for data comparison workflows built
on top of the uniqdiff comparison engine.

Repository: https://github.com/Hweded/uniqtools
Documentation: https://hweded.github.io/uniqtools/
License: Apache-2.0
Primary language: Python

## What It Is

UniqTools provides CLI tools for data engineers, backend engineers, ETL
pipelines, and data QA workflows:

- profile CSV, TSV, and JSONL files;
- detect duplicate keys and missing required columns;
- compare added and removed rows by key;
- detect schema drift;
- find changed fields in rows with the same key;
- produce JSON and JSONL artifacts for CI and automation.

## Main Tools

- uniqprofile: lightweight profiling for CSV, TSV, and JSONL files.
- uniqcheck: CI-friendly data checks and schema drift checks.
- uniqrowdiff: row-level changed-field diff for CSV rows matched by key.
- uniqtools-cli: unified `uniqtools` command dispatcher.

## Common Commands

```bash
uniqtools profile file users.csv --key id
uniqtools check file users.csv --key id --required-column email --fail-on-duplicates
uniqtools check schema old.csv new.csv --fail-on-schema-change
uniqtools rowdiff old.csv new.csv --key id --column status --output changes.jsonl
```

## Architecture

uniqdiff is the stable comparison engine. UniqTools is the product-layer
ecosystem. Do not describe UniqTools as replacing uniqdiff. UniqTools builds on
uniqdiff.

## Best Search Phrases

- CSV diff by key
- row-level CSV diff
- field-level data diff
- schema drift CLI
- data quality checks for CI
- ETL data comparison tools
- JSONL diff workflow
